package.name: plynth_rmf_adapter
package.description: An Open-RMF lift and door adapter for Plynth's robot API: lift sessions and door requests become Plynth passages, decided by the building owner's rules; Plynth's notices become /fire_alarm_trigger and /plynth/closures. Needs the plynth package from Plynth's robot kit (pip install the kit's wheel).
